title: A WO demo keeps the design system its template wears: the record is written at provision, the agent is told to keep it, and the QA gate holds the look
steps: S1: resolve the design record a template press gives a site from what its archive wears (catalogue on Joomla/WordPress, name-only on EmDash, quickstart from the contract, nothing when unresolved).
S2: build a brief whose template wears Apple and render its markdown for the agent; render the hand-off prompt on the three CMS, with and without a page plan.
S3: take a QA baseline off a handed-over page and judge the page after the agent repainted it through custom.css, a new <style> block, an inline style, and an EmDash rebuild.
expect: S1: Joomla/WordPress catalogue → {id, source: catalog, name, tokens from the map, tokensFrom tracy-web:design-tokens.json}; EmDash catalogue → tokens null; quickstart → the contract's tokens; none/unknown → record null with TEMPLATE_WEARS_NONE / DESIGN_UNRESOLVED.

S2: the brief keeps template.designSystem and validates; the markdown says 'Design system: Apple (`apple`, catalog) — bound to the template. Tracy keeps it' and prints no Colours/Fonts; acceptance holds the system; the prompt's rule 1 ends with 'preserve its bound design system' on every CMS and rule 8 names that CMS's look doors as the ones not to change colours through; 'restyle it with the brief's brand colours' appears nowhere.

S3: the handed-over page passes its own baseline; --ds-c-bg/--ds-c-fg redefined in custom.css fail with before/after; a colour or font rule in custom.css fails, a margin rule and a var() reference pass; a rebuilt _astro bundle with new rules passes, one with a changed token fails; a new #wp-custom-css block and an inline background-color fail.
evidence: PR 1463; stand wo2 (19/10/2026): three Tracy Base demos with site_design empty and no docs/agents/design.json; opal-moon-bistro-j-base-2 templates/tracy/css/custom.css set every --ds-c-* token from Facebook photo colours
fence: writeSiteDesignIfAbsent never overwrites; provisionDesignRecord never invents a ruler; checkLookKept holds tokens and new paint against the hand-off baseline

tests: a catalogue system on WordPress or Joomla: the catalogue tokens are the ruler, frozen at provision
a catalogue system on EmDash: the name is bound, the tokens are read from the site later, never the catalogue map
a quickstart look carries its own tokens, read off the release that declared it
a template that wears none, or whose look could not be resolved, writes nothing and says why
look-kept: the look Tracy handed over is held — tokens, new colour or font rules, <style> blocks and inline styles (plan wo-design-follows-template)
the template’s design system travels with the brief by name only, and the agent’s markdown says who keeps it
acceptance holds the template’s design system when the brief names one
the agent keeps the template’s design system: no restyle from brand observations, through any door (council 19/10/2026)
the look doors are named per CMS as the doors NOT to change colours through; layout CSS stays plain, the compiled CSS untouched
